categories.main_business_segments: Suzhou Zelgen Biopharmaceuticals Co., Ltd. focuses on innovative pharmaceutical development in oncology, bleeding and hematological diseases, immune-inflammatory diseases, and hepatobiliary diseases. The company develops and commercializes small molecule targeted drugs and biologics, including recombinant proteins and bispecific antibodies. Key marketed products include Donafenib tablets for liver and thyroid cancers and recombinant human thrombin for surgical hemostasis. The company also has a robust pipeline of clinical-stage drugs targeting various cancers and autoimmune diseases.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes two core technology platforms: a small molecule drug R&D and industrialization platform, and a complex recombinant protein and antibody drug R&D and industrialization platform. Technologies include chemical synthesis, recombinant gene technology for protein drugs, antibody engineering for bispecific and trispecific antibodies, and advanced manufacturing compliant with GMP standards. Production methods involve outsourced raw material synthesis and in-house GMP-compliant manufacturing of oral solid formulations and recombinant proteins.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Primary customers are hospitals and pharmacies across China, with products distributed through GSP-certified distributors including major pharmaceutical logistics companies. The company serves patients with advanced liver cancer, thyroid cancer, hematological malignancies, autoimmune diseases, and surgical bleeding conditions. The market focus is on China, with ongoing efforts to expand international clinical trials and regulatory approvals, particularly in the US.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China, with registered offices and production facilities in Jiangsu Province (Kunshan) and Shanghai. It has an overseas subsidiary, Gensun Biopharma Inc., based in California, USA, focusing on drug R&D. The marketed products cover mainland China and the Greater China region, including Hong Kong, Macau, and Taiwan, especially through exclusive marketing agreements.
categories.supply_chain_position: Zelgen operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the pharmaceutical supply chain. It conducts in-house drug discovery, clinical development, and commercial manufacturing of finished dosage forms. Raw materials and active pharmaceutical ingredients (APIs) are procured through qualified external suppliers. The company also manages sales, marketing, and distribution through third-party distributors and direct sales teams.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes innovation in small molecule targeted therapies and biologics, especially bispecific and trispecific antibodies for oncology and immune diseases. It focuses on developing first-in-class and best-in-class drugs addressing unmet clinical needs in cancer, bleeding, and autoimmune diseases. R&D efforts include advancing late-stage clinical trials, expanding indications, and pursuing international regulatory approvals. The strategy emphasizes integrated small molecule and immunotherapy combinations and building global competitive capabilities.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through product sales of pharmaceutical drugs, including Donafenib tablets and recombinant human thrombin. The company also earns income from licensing and milestone payments related to intellectual property and commercial partnerships. Sales are conducted mainly via distributors under exclusive agreements and direct sales teams targeting hospitals and pharmacies. Government healthcare reimbursement inclusion supports market penetration and revenue growth.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Zelgen is positioned as an innovative biopharmaceutical company in China with a focus on oncology and immune-inflammatory diseases. It competes with domestic and international pharmaceutical companies developing targeted small molecules and biologics. The company holds a leading position in certain niches, such as being the first domestic JAK inhibitor (Jakotinib) to submit an NDA and having the only recombinant human thrombin produced by recombinant gene technology in China. It faces competition from established global players and generic manufacturers in overlapping indications.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, the company reported revenue of approximately RMB 386 million, a 27.8% increase year-over-year, driven by the commercial expansion of Donafenib. Despite revenue growth, the company remains unprofitable with a net loss attributable to shareholders of RMB 278.6 million, though losses have narrowed compared to prior years. Total assets grew 73% to RMB 2.89 billion, and shareholders' equity increased 115% to RMB 1.63 billion, supported by successful equity financing raising over RMB 1.18 billion. R&D investment remains high, accounting for over 128% of revenue.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Zelgen emphasizes its differentiated product pipeline featuring innovative, first-in-class and best-in-class small molecule and biologic drugs with strong intellectual property protection. Its marketed products, such as Donafenib and recombinant human thrombin, offer clinical advantages including broad-spectrum anti-tumor efficacy, safety, and unique recombinant production technology. The company leverages integrated platforms combining small molecule targeted therapies with next-generation antibody immunotherapies to address unmet medical needs. Its strong clinical data, inclusion in national reimbursement lists, and exclusive marketing partnerships enhance its competitive positioning.
